name: Cloud of Shards
body:
School conjuration (creation) [force]; Level bloodrager 2, magus 2, sorcerer/wizard 2, summoner 2, unchained summoner 2

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M (a shard of glass)

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5ft./2 levels)
Area 5-foot square
Duration 1 round/level (D)
Saving Throw Reflex half; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You utter the words of the spell releasing the bit of glass, creating an immovable cloud of spinning force shards in a 5-foot-cube. Any creature entering the area or beginning their turn in the area takes 1d6 points of magical slashing damage per caster level (maximum 10d6), with a Reflex save for half damage.

A cloud of shards provides cover (+4 bonus to AC, +2 bonus on Reflex saves) against attacks made through it.
